steps.content: The white landscape stretches in every direction, too bright to behold.
You take tentative steps forward. But with every step you take, the white landscape shudders, and some pieces of it fall off.
From the other end of the shackles come faint vibrations. You sense that she's still alive.
You also sense that she's asking for help.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: There's no time left...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Don't let the Bottle of Dreams consume you!
Though Marv has been eliminated, its heart, the Bottle of Dreams, has become integrated with Serpent.
Serpent's obsession with happiness has allowed Marv's heart to latch onto her Realm of Dreams like a parasite.
It has to be fed constantly, or it'll start torturing its host ceaselessly.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Darn it!
You make a determined dash in the direction your shackles have pointed you.
The white landscape crumbles away, as black masses of sludge rise up to chase you like moths after light. Finally, you see Serpent ahead.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Serpent! Wake up!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Stop yourself from sinking!
Thud! Thud!
Your viscera contract viciously, and then an excruciating pain sweeps over you.
You see that Serpent has curled into a ball, howling and howling.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Stop devouring... Stop!

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Every dream ends. I have... I have no happiness left... None at all...

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Nobody can save me... I...
The last piece of whiteness falls off. The white landscape is gone; in its place is a void of dark redness.
Serpent's eyes open abruptly, looking deep into yours.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: I'm going to be buried in pain...
All of a sudden, an avalanche of black sludge comes rushing down and swallows you up.
The black sludge makes its way into your mouth and your ears, suffocating you.
A myriad of pained voices howls in your ears.
"Get lost, you monster!"
"Ah? Why are you still alive?"
"You're just a tool for making money!"
"The world would be a better place without you."
"So disgusting!!"
You clamp your hands over your ears and close your eyes.
You force your legs to move, running desperately in the direction you are sensing.
You're getting closer and closer to her—you can sense it. But right before you can touch her, a huge winged monster rises up behind her.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Can you... bring me happiness?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Wake up, Serpent!
Red thorny tentacles penetrate the all-encompassing darkness, spread to where the girl is, and ensnare her like snakes.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Don't let Marv and the Bottle of Dreams control you!

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Chief...?
All around, the howling voices are still tormenting your ears, as the gigantic black Marv runs through Serpent's body again and again to attack you.
It floats about, giving cries of joy and pain, and subjects Serpent to the sufferings the owners of those pained voices once went through.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Painful... so painful...

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Make it stop...!

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Give me... your happiness!!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Serpent, I do not have a realm of dreams. You have no access to my happiness here.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You knew this, and you still brought me here... Why?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Isn't this... a cry for help?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's torturing you, and it feeds on happiness, and you brought in someone whose happiness can't be accessed here.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Yes, yes!!

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: I've tried everything I could...

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: But you don't recognize my happiness. I'll be tormented by pain forever!

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Tormented forever and ever!
Serpent acknowledges her pain and gives up her chase for happiness, and having seen this, Marv's shadow advances on you frantically.
You lunge forward, pick up Serpent, and roll to one side to avoid its attack.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Calm down, Serpent.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I cannot enter a Realm of Dreams after drinking Ambrosia, because all my happiness is rooted in reality.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: How can there be any happiness in the real world?! Under all the happiness... it's overrun with sufferings!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: There is happiness, Serpent...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: All my happiness and joy are on the other side of the shackles.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Everything I've been through since I woke up is a bundle of tribulations. My life would be nothing but pain if not for those... Sinners. They're my only source of happiness and joy.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: They can't be recreated in the Realm of Dreams, because they're unique. That's why I'm not able to fall into a dream after drinking Ambrosia.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You're my Sinner too... In this place, I can't acknowledge the happiness you've collected. All I can do is share your pain.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Share my pain...?

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: You're not even willing to acknowledge my pain...

Black Marv picks itself up from the floor and soars into the air again, shrieking and screaming, a pink light blinking in its eyes. You also notice the same pink light on Serpent's chest. That's the light of the Bottle of Dreams!

The pink light blinks out, and Marv becomes more vicious, as if it has absorbed the power of the Bottle of Dreams. Serpent, on the other hand, seems to have had her energy sucked out, and she falls into your arms.
You carry Serpent on your back and, with great difficulty, dodge oncoming attacks.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Listen! I've never, ever denied your pain. And I've never expected you to accept or forget everything you've been through.
As you roll out of the way of an oncoming attack while protecting Serpent, a compact music box falls out of your pocket.

The music box, a ubiquitous item in the amusement park, starts playing music as a funny-looking circus spins on top. You brought it to the interrogation room and intended to give it to Serpent as a gift.
Serpent hears the music and opens her eyes slowly. Marv's attacks halt for a second. You seize the opportunity by reactivating the shackles to cut off the Bottle of Dreams' control over Serpent.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Serpent, do you know why you were rejected by the Carnival, even though you think you are a monster?

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: W-why?
Serpent's quivering voice reverberates around the Realm of Dreams, sounding like she's about to cry.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Because I am not allowed to be happy... even as a monster?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Because you're NOT a monster!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You are in great pain, but you are still a human. In fact, pain is what makes a human more human.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: But it's too painful, everyone is in pain. I don't want this... I don't want this!
Serpent curls up, and Marv breaks the restraint imposed by the shackles and turns into a black sludge, clinging to Serpent to drag her under.
Ignoring the sludge, you quickly thrust your hand in it, and grab Serpent to prevent her from sinking.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If you don't want this, you don't have to.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Like I said, I don't deny pain, but I don't glorify it either.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Because pain is pain, and it should be ameliorated with compassion and love.
Serpent looks up at you, tears still streaming down her cheeks, once again that kid wailing outside the gate of the amusement park.
You open your arms, just like she did, as if to extend her an embrace.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You told me everything about yourself, wanting me to experience what you think is happiness.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But that's not true happiness. True happiness comes from <i>love<i>, all the love you've been missing, under all the unavoidable shadows. Love can give you the strength to endure pain, to conquer sorrow.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: And they gather to become happiness for you.
Perhaps because of your welcoming body language or your words, or both, Serpent's crying subsides. The black sludge stops churning and slowly retreats. And then she falls into your embrace.
The sky and ground stop shaking. The white light shines through once again.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: But I... I am already in this shadow of darkness.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: I've missed so much of this "love" you've been talking about, and that's because I don't know what it really looks like.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: My journey ahead is still paved with suffering.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Mine too, Serpent.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The first thing I learned about this world was all its danger and suffering. But I know that... danger and suffering are only one part of this world, and of me.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Do you remember what I said about why I won't fall into a dream after drinking Ambrosia?

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: I do...

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: You said your happiness is lying on the other side of your shackles.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Yes. And now, you're there too.
You shake Serpent's hand which you've been holding and give her a gentle smile.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Since both our futures will be full of suffering, why don't we search for love and happiness under that suffering, together?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: From now on, you and I are tied together... Whether you still want to find happiness or not, whether you're able to find it or not.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: So at least... let me share your pain in our journey ahead.
Serpent looks at you, tears budding in the corners of her eyes once again.
This time, the Realm of Dreams doesn't shake or shatter.
Serpent leans closer and rests her head on your shoulder, her breathing deep and rhythmic, as if she is about to fall asleep.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Will you help me find true happiness...?

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: If I stay by your side... I can find true happiness?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I don't lie, nor do my shackles.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Uh, that's wonderful...
Serpent picks up her weapon and stabs herself in the heart.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Save me then, Chief...
She places your hand on the gaping wound.
It's damp, warm to the touch, giving you the chills, and your fingertips feel the vibrations of a rhythmic heartbeat.
You activate the shackles, guide them down the open wound, and aim them at the object clinging stubbornly to the wound—a small, black moth.

steps.speaker: Marv
steps.content: Ahhh!!!
The white light gets brighter and brighter in the realm until you can see nothing. The only things you feel are the warmth of Serpent in your arms, and her strong heartbeat.
You stare at the remaining pieces on the table, lost in thought.
You've smashed the bottle in the Realm of Dreams to save Serpent. Only one piece remains. You now have no way of finding any clue linked to the bottle.

Everything you saw in the Realm of Dreams has vanished with the realm itself. The procession of monsters, the festooned circus wagon, the entrance where red contamination concentrates... You have no way of untangling their secrets now.
At least you now know that Marv was not created by Serpent with her power, but by someone else.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Who created this monster? Even the residues of its power were strong enough to control an S-class Sinner...?
The interrogation has ended, but more questions have arisen; it gives you a headache.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Baby step, baby step... Serpent is one of us now.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Speaking of which, can you please keep a rein on this Sinner of yours?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: N-Nightingale?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Serpent, Sinner No. 948, turns training sessions into circus shows without permission, and repeatedly terrorizes other Sinners and staff members with her snake.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: She has also been rude to others multiple times... And justifies her action by saying that she just wants to know if they love her. Don't you think you should do something about it?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Sigh...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'll be right there. Adjutant, could you find it in your heart to tell her you like her very much?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: That would help quiet her down a bit.
